name: apexuse
description: Local-first cross-platform Computer Use MCP server using native Accessibility, Set-of-Mark visual grounding, OCR, and workflow memory

interface.shortDescription: Native Accessibility + Set-of-Mark desktop and browser control
interface.longDescription: Local-first cross-platform Computer Use MCP server for macOS, Windows, and Linux. Inspects apps via batched native Accessibility trees with incremental AX diffs, fuses Set-of-Mark [m1]..[mN] visual grounding and OCR, runs batched multi-step run_actions, and records reusable local workflow macros.
defaultPrompt: List running desktop applications and inspect the frontmost window with ApexUse.
Use visual_inspect Set-of-Mark grounding and semantic target actions to complete a multi-step UI flow.
Check ApexUse workflow memory for matching macros or record a repeatable desktop workflow.
